name: Sheppard AFB
description: Home of the 82nd Training Wing. The largest and most diverse training base in Air Education and Training Command, training thousands of Airmen annually in aircraft maintenance, civil engineering, and medical career fields.

currentNotifications.title: Missile Gate Operations Update
currentNotifications.body: Temporary changes to Missile Gate access. Use alternate gates during maintenance.

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 entry point with visitor processing. Located off I-44 / State Hwy 240.

gates.name: Missile Road Gate
gates.notes: Visitor Control Center located here. Closed weekends and holidays.
gates.address: 210 Missile Rd, Bldg 1405, Sheppard AFB, TX 76311

gates.name: Clinic Gate
gates.notes: Limited hours; inbound morning, outbound evening only.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 1405)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0630-1630; closed holidays and 3rd Wednesday of each month
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. Walk-ins processed in order of arrival.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dormitory Management (940-676-5218) for unaccompanied housing or Sheppard Inn (940-676-3311) for temporary lodging. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.body: 82 FSS, M&FRC, and official Sheppard sites for in-processing and training support.
